title: Perturbation Parameter
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the dimensionless parameter |q gamma_12 alpha / hbar| as small for perturbation theory.

title: Excitation Probability
description: Essential Criteria: Calculate the probability P_2 = (q r_{12} alpha / hbar)^2 for the atom to be in the excited state.

title: Dipole Moment Expectation
description: Important Criteria: Derive the expectation value of the dipole moment as <r> = -2 alpha q r_{12}^2 / hbar sin(omega_0 (t - t_1)).

title: Multiple Particle Probability
description: Important Criteria: Find the probability P_2(N tau) = (N alpha q r_{12} / hbar)^2 for the atom after N particles.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign errors in the calculations of coefficients and probabilities.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure all terms are dimensionally consistent, particularly in the final expressions.
